title: feat(types)!: ObjectGridSchema.defaultFilters and the flat gantt / map filter follow their @objectstack/spec rows by reference (objectui#6152, round 10)
body:
Part of #6152 (round 10). Round 11 (the list VIEW's per-view-type blocks) is still to come, so #6152 remains open.

Clause-②: yes — it widens: the flat `ObjectGridSchema.defaultFilters` mirror, and through it an `object-view`'s `table.defaultFilters`, now ACCEPTS the `ViewFilterRule` array the `object-grid` row declares (the old `z.record(z.string(), z.any())` refused it). It narrows: the record form of `defaultFilters` is refused on both faces, and the flat `ObjectGanttSchema` / `ObjectMapSchema` `filter` refuse the AST tuple array they took as `any[]`.

## What changed

Three flat members now take their `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 row's own member by reference, on the TypeScript interface (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`) and on the zod mirror (`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`):

| member | was | now |
|---|---|---|
| `ObjectGridSchema.defaultFilters` | `Record` (string keys, any values) / `z.record(z.string(), z.any())` | `ObjectGridProps['defaultFilters']` / `ObjectGridPropsSchema.shape.defaultFilters` |
| `ObjectGanttSchema.filter` | `any[]` / `z.array(z.any())` | `ObjectGanttProps['filter']` / `ObjectGanttPropsSchema.shape.filter` |
| `ObjectMapSchema.filter` | `any[]` / `z.array(z.any())` | `ObjectMapProps['filter']` / `ObjectMapPropsSchema.shape.filter` |

Each is the `ViewFilterRule` array `[{ field, operator, value }, ...]`. The zod members are the rows' own objects (identity is pinned), so a record is refused with the protocol's own `ruleArrayFilterError` message, which computes the rule array from the author's keys. `defaultFilters` keeps its `@deprecated` tag: the row's own description still says "Prefer `filter`".

**Doors.** The flat grid mirror is the source of the `object-view` `table` slot, so `table.defaultFilters` (objectui's own door) moves with it on the tolerant face, the strict face and `safeValidateSchema`. The authored `object-grid` node's `properties` bag is the row itself and already gave these verdicts (pinned as a control). The flat gantt / map mirrors are not authoring arms (objectui#10859): their authored nodes' bags are the rows, which already refused the tuple array, so no authored door moves there.

**No reader changed.** `ObjectGrid` already lowers `defaultFilters` through the same `toFilterNode` sink as `filter` (objectui#4082), so the spec's shape was already honoured; this was a declaration gap, not an implementation gap.

**Sentences this head would have made false, repaired** (each called the key `Record` typed): the `defaultFilters` comment in `ObjectGrid.tsx`'s load effect; the `toFilterNode` docblock in `packages/core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts`; the `mergeFilterNodes` comment in `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` (outside the claim's listed surface: a one-comment repair, stated here as the round-9 ACCEPT treated its two doc sentences); and the "write this / not this" row in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx` and `packages/plugin-view/README.md`, which taught `defaultFilters` as a record of field to value (equality-only).

## Measurement first

**1. The spec's shape** (installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0, `ui/component.zod.ts`): the `object-grid` row's `defaultFilters` is `z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema, { error: ruleArrayFilterError(...) }).optional()`, the same wrapper chain as `filter`, described "Legacy base-filter fallback, read only when `filter` is absent ... Prefer `filter`" (narrowed, not retired, by the row's own note). The gantt and map rows' `filter` are the same rule-array member. The pin re-reads all three on every run.

**2. The reader (H2 holds).** Measured through the registered `object-grid` renderer and a `ValueDataSource` that applies the `$filter` it receives: `defaultFilters: [{ field: 'status', operator: 'equals', value: 'open' }]` sends `[['status', 'equals', 'open']]` and draws the two open rows of three; the same array written as `filter` sends the same `$filter` and draws the same rows. Lit control: a `closed` rule moves both readings (one row). Controls: no key draws all three and sends no `$filter`; written both ways, `filter` wins. New pin: `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.defaultFiltersRuleArray-6152.test.tsx`.

**3. Corpus census, before any edit.** A TypeScript-AST census over the authored corpus (`examples/` with the schema catalog, `content/`, `skills/`, `docs/`, `apps/`, the root README and every package README; tests and CHANGELOGs excluded): 941 files. Controls: the extractor saw 53 `object-grid`, 46 `object-view`, 27 `object-gantt` and 22 `object-map` node literals, and 11 `filter` keys on typed nodes.

| looked for | authored occurrences |
|---|---|
| a `defaultFilters` key on any node (flat, in a bag, or in an `object-view` `table`), either shape | **0** |
| a `filter` on an `object-gantt` / `object-map` node, flat or in its bag, any shape | **0** |
| prose naming `defaultFilters` | 9 lines in 2 documents (`plugin-view.mdx`, `plugin-view` README); 2 of them taught the record shape, corrected here |

objectstack (read-only): no authored `defaultFilters` outside tests and the spec package; the spec ships its own migration (`object-grid-default-filters-rule-array`).

**Test fixtures, classified separately.** Re-spelled to the rule array because a typed fixture became a `tsc` error: `ObjectGrid.filterContextTokens-10607` (2 cells), `ObjectView.tableSlotRelay-10976` (1, now a value distinct from `filter`'s so a swap cannot read as arrival), `ObjectMap.schemaAlignment` (1), `gantt-flat-config-declared-keys` (the `GOOD` value and the `_FilterIsDeclared` row); `object-gallery-filter-9309`'s source census updated for the two new spellings. Left as written: 18 record-valued cells in 5 untyped runtime tests (`gridDefaultFiltersLowering`, `ObjectGrid.malformedFilter-9050`, `ObjectView.canonicalTableKeys`, `ObjectView.filterSources`, `ObjectView.namedViewContextTokens-10506`). They pin the READ, which did not narrow (the objectui#10199 split, as round 8 left its AST fixtures); `gridDefaultFiltersLowering`'s two comments that called the record "the declared shape" now say "declared until this round".

**H1** holds for authored nodes (zero) and is falsified in prose: two documentation rows taught the record. **H3** holds: the flat gantt / map `filter` readers are `ObjectGantt` and `ObjectMap` (each `useResolvedFilter(schema.filter, …)` onto `$filter`), plus `ObjectMap`'s legacy `filter.map` probe, which reads the value as `unknown`, warns, and was already outside `any[]` for a record. `ElementDataSourceGate` writes a merged AST to `filter` at runtime, and `ListView` writes its effective filter onto a gantt node from an `unknown`-typed value. `tsc` on all of them stays green; no renderer changed.

**Not by reference, stated:** the tuple-array refusal is the row's element-level message (`expected object, received array` at `filter.0`), which does not name the rule array; only the record refusal carries the conversion. Changing that would mean a local copy of the member, so it is left to the spec.

## Tests

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/plugin-grid/ packages/plugin-gantt/ packages/plugin-map/ packages/plugin-view/ packages/core/ apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: `Test Files  962 passed | 1 skipped (963)`, `Tests  17511 passed | 141 skipped (17652)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/__tests__/`: `Test Files  179 passed | 2 skipped (181)`, `Tests  5452 passed | 2 skipped (5454)`.
- The lock held 26m07s for both and the doc gates' build closure (35/35 turbo tasks), on a shared box.
- The two new pins alone: the `@object-ui/types` round-10 pin (`grid-default-filters-gantt-map-filter-round10-6152.test.ts`) 84 tests; the `plugin-grid` H2 pin 5 tests.

**`type-check`** (script name echoed on every row) after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --filter='@object-ui/example-schema-catalog^...'` (34/34 tasks): `types`, `core`, `app-shell`, `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-designer`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-tree`, `plugin-view`, `console`, `example-schema-catalog`: every package whose source names `ObjectGridSchema`, `ObjectGanttSchema`, `ObjectMapSchema` or `ObjectViewSchema` (the consumers, downstream of `@object-ui/types`). The first sweep was red only on the three typed fixtures above (`plugin-grid`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-view` test configs; every package's `src` compiled); green after the re-spelling, against a rebuilt `types` dist.

**Gates**, all exit 0, on the same head after that build:

- `pnpm check:doc-snippets` (784 of 784 blocks judged, 0 failed), `check:doc-examples`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:doc-types`, `check:readme-exports`
- `check:spec-symbols`; `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only, no row for these members)
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (13 source files of 5 released packages, 1 changeset), `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`
- `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 16 paths: NOT GOVERNED

**ESLint** over the 13 changed TS files: 0 errors (warnings pre-existing `no-explicit-any` / react-hooks).

## Ablations (one-shot, through `ablation-replace.mjs`; each mutation proven on disk, each restore to the `HEAD` blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`)

Predictions were written before the runs; every observed direction matched.

- **A.** `defaultFilters` mirror back to `z.record(z.string(), z.any()).optional()`: the round-10 pin goes **27 red / 57 green**, exactly the predicted set (member identity; the grid `defaultFilters` verdict rows for the rule array, the empty array, the record and the empty record; on each of the three doors the rule-array, record and tuple rows and the same four verdict rows; the `object-view` mirror's slot). Green: the precondition, the gantt / map rows, the grid `filter` lit control, the door lit controls, the authored-bag control.
- **B.** gantt mirror `filter` back to `z.array(z.any()).optional()`: **4 red** (the gantt / map identity test; the gantt tuple, AST and unknown-operator verdict rows); `gantt-flat-config-declared-keys` stays green (its refused value is a string).
- **C.** a consumer literal in `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, typed `ObjectGridSchema`, with `defaultFilters: { status: 'open' }`: `plugin-grid` `tsc` **red** (`TS2353`, `status` not in the rule type); control leg with the rule array **green**. This proves the consumer reads the rebuilt `.d.ts`.
- **D.** the same in `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` with `filter: [['status', '=', 'open']]`: **red** (`TS2322`); control leg **green**.
- The first C/D attempt was a no-op: `ablation-replace` refused it because the replacement re-contained the anchor, ran nothing, and restored. Re-run with an anchor-altering replacement; the numbers above are the second attempt's.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`'s `buildEffectiveFilter` docblock still says `table.defaultFilters` is "declared `Record`". Fenced from this round (objectui#11860 is in flight on that file). Carrier: objectui#11860's PR, or the next PR that touches `ListView.tsx`.
- `ObjectView.tsx`'s `gridSchema` memo comment says `ObjectGrid` "raw-assigns the legacy" `defaultFilters` slot. That has been false since objectui#4082 (it is lowered through the same sink), not made false here. Carrier: the next PR that touches that memo.
- The gantt and map `Schema API` blocks in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx` / `plugin-map.mdx` spell the bag's `filter` as an array of `any`. Not false (the row takes an array), only imprecise. Carrier: none.
